import re

def loop_inbox_threads(gmail_token, query, min_created_at, max_created_at, page_limit=20):
    threads=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token['access_token'], query=query, min_created_at=min_created_at, max_created_at=max_created_at, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
        if not page:
            break
        page_items = page if isinstance(page, list) else page.get('success', [])
        if not page_items:
            break
        threads.extend(page_items)
        page_index += 1
    return threads
